name: Nadiral-Bergschrund
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around geothermal vent fields, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
